integrity: An explicit universal all-parameter proof accompanies a separate finite exact checker; the checker corroborates but cannot replace the proof. No human peer review or independent external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a cyclic planar difference set, whose existence is guaranteed for prime-power orders by Singer; no assertion about non-prime-power existence.
Provides the terminal avalanche complex, not an inter-round persistence classification or other firing convention.
The integral splitting is noncanonical and uses a chosen unique oriented unit difference.
The nonequivariant projective-plane cycle rank is previously known and is not claimed as a new rank calculation.
No independently conducted mathematical audit is asserted; unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: An integral equivariant Cayley collapse for Singer-supported avalanche complexes
